title: The pup's bed, moved
logline: The pup's bed moved from under the table to beside the door, where the step is, the blanket in it, the pup, nine, in it. Nearer the out. The page doesn't say why; the step page in 2027 will.

panels.composition: A dog bed with a wool blanket set beside a garage door by the step instead of beneath the table, a small three-legged dog lying in it, the drafting table across the room.

characters.pose: in the bed by the door
